# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Commands

**Run the development server:**
```bash
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

**Run Alembic migrations:**
```bash
# Apply all pending migrations
alembic upgrade head

# Create a new autogenerated migration
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "description"

# Rollback one step
alembic downgrade -1
```

**Install dependencies:**
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Architecture

This is an async FastAPI e-commerce REST API backed by PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async).

**Key layers:**

- `app/main.py` — FastAPI app entry point; includes all three routers
- `app/database.py` — defines `async_engine`, `async_session_maker`, and `Base`; also contains a legacy synchronous SQLite setup that is unused (only the async PostgreSQL path is active)
- `app/db_depends.py` — provides `get_async_db` dependency (yields `AsyncSession`); also contains an unused synchronous `get_db` generator
- `app/auth.py` — JWT auth (PyJWT + bcrypt); `get_current_user` dependency decodes bearer tokens; `get_current_seller` gates seller-only routes
- `app/config.py` — loads `SECRET_KEY` from `.env`; `ALGORITHM = 'HS256'`
- `app/schemas.py` — Pydantic v2 request/response models for all three entities
- `app/models/` — SQLAlchemy ORM models: `User`, `Category` (self-referential, hierarchical), `Product` (FK to both `categories` and `users`)
- `app/routers/` — one router per resource (`categories`, `products`, `users`), all async

**Auth flow:**
`POST /users/` registers a user (`buyer` or `seller`). `POST /users/token` returns a JWT. Seller-only endpoints (`POST/PUT/DELETE /products/`) require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and the user's `role == "seller"`. Sellers may only modify their own products (`seller_id == current_user.id`).

**Soft deletes:** Both `Category` and `Product` use `is_active=False` instead of actual row deletion. All read queries filter on `is_active == True`.

**Migrations:** Located in `app/migragions/` (note the typo in the directory name). The `env.py` is configured for async migrations using `asyncpg`.

**Database connection string** is hardcoded in both `app/database.py` and `alembic.ini`. The `.env` file only needs `SECRET_KEY`.
